limitations.text: Only one image candidate was usable and provenance-checked in this pass. The Commons description page search result gave its identity and public-domain status, but direct page opens returned cache-miss errors. No actual pixels were inspected; the harness visual agent should confirm the redraw's appearance and educational fit.

Academia Sinica's 毛 evolution record provides bronze, Chu manuscript, and seal-stage labels, but that specific database page is marked all rights reserved; Xiaoxuetang query images have a CC0 notice, but no specific Xiaoxuetang 毛 image was selected or inspected as an alternative.
